audit_events	CREATE TABLE `audit_events` (
  `event_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `entity_type` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `entity_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `action` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `event_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `details` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`event_id`),
  KEY `ix_audit_entity` (`entity_type`,`entity_id`,`event_time`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
customers	CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `customer_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `external_ref` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(120) NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(160) NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('active','paused','closed') NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`customer_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_customers_external_ref` (`external_ref`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_customers_email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
orders	CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `customer_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `order_ref` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `total_cents` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','paid','shipped','cancelled') NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_orders_ref` (`order_ref`),
  KEY `ix_orders_customer_created` (`customer_id`,`created_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`customer_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
order_items	CREATE TABLE `order_items` (
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `line_no` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `sku` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `quantity` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `unit_price_cents` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`,`line_no`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_order_items_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`order_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4

audit_events	CREATE TABLE `audit_events` (
  `event_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `entity_type` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `entity_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,

) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
customers	CREATE TABLE `customers` (
  `customer_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `external_ref` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(120) NOT NULL,

  UNIQUE KEY `uq_customers_email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
orders	CREATE TABLE `orders` (
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `customer_id` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `order_ref` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `total_cents` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,

  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_orders_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customers` (`customer_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci
order_items	CREATE TABLE `order_items` (
  `order_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `line_no` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `sku` varchar(40) NOT NULL,
  `quantity` smallint(5) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `unit_price_cents` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`order_id`,`line_no`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_order_items_order` FOREIGN KEY (`order_id`) REFERENCES `orders` (`order_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','S',TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,NON_UNIQUE,SEQ_IN_INDEX,COLUMN_NAME,COALESCE(SUB_PART,'<NULL>'),INDEX_TYPE) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,INDEX_NAME,SEQ_IN_INDEX; SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','K',TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,CONSTRAINT_TYPE) FROM information_schema.TABLE_CONSTRAINTS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME; SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','F',CONSTRAINT_NAME,TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME,REFERENCED_COLUMN_NAME) FROM information_schema.KEY_COLUMN_USAGE WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' AND REFERENCED_TABLE_NAME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY TABLE_NAME,CONSTRAINT_NAME,ORDINAL_POSITION; SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','R',CONSTRAINT_NAME,UPDATE_RULE,DELETE_RULE) FROM information_schema.REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS WHERE CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA='legacy_shop' ORDER BY CONSTRAINT_NAME; SELECT CONCAT_WS('|','O',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA='legacy_shop'),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA='legacy_shop'),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.EVENTS WHERE EVENT_SCHEMA='legacy_shop'));"; } | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'); printf 'schema_fingerprint_sha256=%s\n' "$schema_hash"; printf 'audit_events_data_sha256='; sudo -n mysql --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT event_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,event_time,details FROM legacy_shop.audit_events ORDER BY event_id" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'; printf 'customers_data_sha256='; sudo -n mysql --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT customer_id,external_ref,full_name,email,status,created_at FROM legacy_shop.customers ORDER BY customer_id" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'; printf 'orders_data_sha256='; sudo -n mysql --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT order_id,customer_id,order_ref,total_cents,status,created_at FROM legacy_shop.orders ORDER BY order_id" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'; printf 'order_items_data_sha256='; sudo -n mysql --batch --raw --skip-column-names -e "SELECT order_id,line_no,sku,quantity,unit_price_cents FROM legacy_shop.order_items ORDER BY order_id,line_no" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
